method.work: Measured synchronous main-thread JS elapsed; nested work is counted once by exclusive sums. Not OS CPU.
method.wait: Wall windows by group union; may overlap main work and each other; do not add to total.
method.imports: Unattributed import wall: I/O/parse/evaluation/scheduling cannot be separated.
method.resourceIO: ResourceTiming may be unavailable for app://; zero entries do not mean zero I/O or cache hit.
method.scope: Instrumented candidate only; untouched trace-off control was not run with incompatible trace fixture; no overhead or speedup claim.
